vb_textbox.text: Choose the gnome with the taller hat first as they will give the most mushrooms. Keeping choosing the one with the taller hat until it gets down to 1 or 2 mushrooms and then swap to the gnome with the shorter hat.  Keeping choose that one until it gets down to 1 or 2 mushrooms and swap back to the one with the taller hat again.  Keep repeating for the duration of the game
